goal: Provide native DC-Agent Feishu/Lark channel governance that integrates with dc_hub, feishu_hub users, card callbacks, and downstream router metadata without replacing the Lark adapter.

acceptance_criteria.description: Explicit pairing policy remains available for special channels: unknown Feishu DM users under pairing policy are blocked, receive a pairing code, and can be approved without network calls.

Default Chat Entry baseline is fail-open for ordinary Feishu direct messages: first-time or identity-partial DM users enter normal chat, receive dc_chat_entry metadata, and are not forced through pairing.
Allowed Feishu DM/group events receive router metadata for peer kind, peer id, agent id, and workspace while non-Lark events are ignored.
Forged card-action text is blocked unless the Lark adapter marked it as a trusted card action.
DC-HUB lists the plugin under the assistant_feishu category.
